note: 'Flood judgment' counts forty: The flood: the rain and the rising waters (Gen 7:4, Gen 7:12, Gen 7:17); After the flood: Noah waits, then opens the window (Gen 8:6)
'Israel receives the law' counts forty: Moses on the mountain, receiving the tablets (Exod 24:18, Deut 9:9, Deut 9:11); Moses on the mountain again, after the golden calf (Exod 34:28)
'Elijah at Horeb' counts forty: Elijah's journey to Horeb (1Kgs 19:8)
'Jesus’ temptation' counts forty: Jesus in the wilderness (Matt 4:2, Mark 1:13, Luke 4:2)
'Twelve spies sent' counts forty: The spies in Canaan (Num 13:25, Num 14:34)
'David defeats Goliath' counts forty: Goliath's challenge (1Sam 17:16)
'Nineveh repents' counts forty: Jonah's warning to Nineveh (Jonah 3:4)
'Manna given' counts forty: Israel in the wilderness (Exod 16:35)
'Rebellion at Kadesh' counts forty: Israel in the wilderness (Num 14:33, Num 14:34)
'Judges raised up' counts forty: Rest after Othniel (Judg 3:11)
'Deborah & Barak defeat Sisera' counts forty: Rest after Deborah and Barak (Judg 5:31)
'Gideon’s victory' counts forty: Rest in the days of Gideon (Judg 8:28)
'Rich young ruler' counts twelve: Thrones, judging the twelve tribes (Matt 19:28)
'Revelation judgments' counts twelve: Twelve thousand sealed from each tribe (Rev 7:5, Rev 7:6, Rev 7:7, Rev 7:8)
'New creation consummation' counts twelve: The city's twelve gates and twelve foundations (Rev 21:12, Rev 21:14, Rev 21:21)
'Israel receives the law' counts twelve: Twelve pillars at the mountain (Exod 24:4)
'Tabernacle instructions' counts twelve: The breastpiece's twelve stones (Exod 28:21)
'Construction of the tabernacle' counts twelve: The breastpiece's twelve stones (Exod 39:14)
'Census of Israel' counts twelve: The twelve leaders and their offerings (Num 1:44)
'Aaron’s budding rod' counts twelve: Twelve staffs (Num 17:2, Num 17:6)
'Crossing the Jordan' counts twelve: Twelve men and twelve stones at the Jordan (Josh 3:12, Josh 4:2, Josh 4:3, Josh 4:4, Josh 4:8, Josh 4:9, Josh 4:20)
'Solomon’s wealth & decline' counts twelve: Ahijah's cloak torn in twelve pieces (1Kgs 11:30); Twelve lions on Solomon's steps (1Kgs 10:20, 2Chr 9:19)
'Elijah vs Baal' counts twelve: Elijah's altar of twelve stones (1Kgs 18:31)
'Temple completed' counts twelve: Twelve goats and twelve bulls for all Israel (Ezra 6:17)
'Ezra’s return' counts twelve: Twelve goats and twelve bulls for all Israel (Ezra 8:35)
'Calling of the Twelve' counts twelve: The Twelve (Matt 10:1, Matt 10:2, Mark 3:14, Mark 3:16, Luke 6:13)
'Mission discourse to the Twelve' counts twelve: The Twelve (Matt 10:5, Mark 6:7, Luke 9:1)
'Bitter water made sweet' counts twelve: Twelve springs at Elim (Exod 15:27)
'Solomon’s wisdom & administration' counts twelve: Solomon's twelve governors (1Kgs 4:7)
'Temple built' counts twelve: The Sea on twelve bronze oxen (1Kgs 7:25, 1Kgs 7:44, 2Chr 4:4, 2Chr 4:15)
'Elijah at Horeb' counts twelve: Elisha plowing with twelve teams of oxen (1Kgs 19:19)
'Levite’s concubine & civil war' counts twelve: The Levite's concubine cut in twelve pieces (Judg 19:29)
'Feeding of the five thousand' counts twelve: Twelve baskets left over (Matt 14:20, Mark 6:43, Luke 9:17, John 6:13)
'Jesus arrested' counts twelve: More than twelve legions of angels, which Jesus says He could ask for (Matt 26:53)
'Woman, dragon, and male child' counts twelve: A crown of twelve stars (Rev 12:1)
